<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,minimum-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover,user-scalable=no"><title>Gull Run: Evo</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#78d2ff;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;touch-action:none;overscroll-behavior:none;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none}
#hud{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;color:#fff;font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.top{position:absolute;top:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-top));left:8px;right:8px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:8px}.badge{background:#143c69cc;border:2px solid #9fd8ff;border-radius:14px;padding:7px 10px;font-size:14px}.badge.center{text-align:center}.badge.right{text-align:right}
.bars{position:absolute;top:max(52px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 52px));left:8px;width:min(360px,70vw);display:grid;gap:6px}.bar{height:16px;background:#173655cc;border:2px solid #95cff8;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}.fill{height:100%}.hp{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7cf46a,#3bcf5d)}.xp{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffe676,#e8b925)}.label{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.tip{position:absolute;bottom:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#143c69dd;border:2px solid #9fd8ff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap}
#joy{display:none;position:fixed;left:20px;bottom:max(22px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 26px));width:120px;height:120px;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}#knob{position:absolute;left:36px;top:36px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.84);border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.93)}
#pause{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:max(16px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 16px));z-index:12;min-width:96px;padding:10px 16px;background:#143c69;border:2px solid #9fd8ff;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #092340;pointer-events:auto}#pause[hidden]{display:none}#pause:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #092340}
#pauseShade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:11;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#07132966;color:#fff;font-size:clamp(34px,8vw,72px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;text-shadow:0 4px 10px #071329;pointer-events:none}#pauseShade[hidden]{display:none}
#overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#47a4ff 0%,#74d7ff 55%,#9ce890 100%);padding:18px}#overlay[hidden]{display:none}.card{max-width:430px;width:min(92vw,430px);background:#ffffffe8;border:4px solid #143c69;border-radius:24px;padding:20px;text-align:center;color:#143c69;box-shadow:0 12px 0 #143c69}.logo{display:block;width:100%;max-width:390px;height:auto;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:14px}p{font-weight:700;line-height:1.4}button{border:none;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 20px;background:#36bd5f;color:#fff;font-size:18px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #1c7a3b}button:disabled{opacity:.7;box-shadow:none}
.small{font-size:12px;opacity:.8;margin-top:10px}.credit{font-size:10px;opacity:.65;margin-top:8px}.credit a{color:inherit}@media(pointer:coarse){#joy{display:block}}@media(max-width:640px){.tip{bottom:max(82px,calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 82px));font-size:11px}.bars{width:min(330px,78vw)}}
</style></head><body>
<canvas id="game"></canvas>
<div id="hud" hidden><div class="top"><div class="badge">SCORE <span id="score">0</span></div><div class="badge center" id="stage">Gull</div><div class="badge right">BEST <span id="best">0</span></div></div>
<div class="bars"><div class="bar"><div class="fill hp" id="hp"></div><div class="label">HEALTH <span id="healthText">100</span></div></div><div class="bar"><div class="fill xp" id="xp"></div><div class="label">EVOLUTION <span id="xpText">0 / 15</span></div></div></div>
<div class="tip">Green = collect • Red = danger • P = pause</div></div>
<div id="joy"><div id="knob"></div></div>
<button id="pause" hidden aria-label="Pause game">PAUSE</button>
<div id="pauseShade" hidden>PAUSED</div>
<div id="overlay"><div class="card"><img class="logo" src="/assets/gull-run-evo-logo.jpeg" alt="Gull Run Evo"><p>Soar from the beach to outer space! Gobble snacks, collect treasure, dodge dangerous enemies, and evolve into the unstoppable Mech Dragon.</p><button id="play">PLAY</button><div class="small">Move with the joystick. Eat to evolve. Avoid red enemies. Collect coins and jewels to regain health.</div><div class="credit">Food, treasure and sailboat icons by <a href="https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Twemoji</a>, licensed under CC BY 4.0.</div></div></div>
<script>
(()=>{
const canvas=document.getElementById('game'), ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const overlay=document.getElementById('overlay'), playBtn=document.getElementById('play'), hud=document.getElementById('hud'), pauseBtn=document.getElementById('pause'), pauseShade=document.getElementById('pauseShade');
const scoreEl=document.getElementById('score'), bestEl=document.getElementById('best'), stageEl=document.getElementById('stage'), hpEl=document.getElementById('hp'), xpEl=document.getElementById('xp'), healthText=document.getElementById('healthText'), xpText=document.getElementById('xpText');
const joy=document.getElementById('joy'), knob=document.getElementById('knob');
['gesturestart','gesturechange','gestureend'].forEach(type=>document.addEventListener(type,event=>event.preventDefault(),{passive:false}));
document.addEventListener('touchmove',event=>{if(event.touches.length>1)event.preventDefault();},{passive:false});
let lastTouchEnd=0; document.addEventListener('touchend',event=>{const now=Date.now();if(now-lastTouchEnd<300)event.preventDefault();lastTouchEnd=now;},{passive:false});
let W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight,DPR=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.75);
function resize(){W=innerWidth;H=innerHeight;DPR=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,1.75);canvas.width=W*DPR;canvas.height=H*DPR;ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';} addEventListener('resize',resize,{passive:true}); resize();
const atlas=new Image(); atlas.src='data:image/webp;base64,
